entries.head: traceql
entries.message: traceql: spanset op %s is not a structural relation
entries.rationale: callers pre-filter to the structural operator set before consulting this mapper

guard: past exhaustive switch op over [case traceql.OpSpansetChild; case traceql.OpSpansetParent; case traceql.OpSpansetDescendant; case traceql.OpSpansetAncestor; case traceql.OpSpansetSibling; case traceql.OpSpansetNotChild; case traceql.OpSpansetNotParent; case traceql.OpSpansetNotDescendant; case traceql.OpSpansetNotAncestor; case traceql.OpSpansetNotSibling; case traceql.OpSpansetUnionChild; case traceql.OpSpansetUnionParent; case traceql.OpSpansetUnionDescendant; case traceql.OpSpansetUnionAncestor; case traceql.OpSpansetUnionSibling]
